dogs: Allowed: up to two dogs in designated dog-friendly bedrooms (charge applies)

overview: The Seagate is a pub with rooms on the quay at Appledore, where the Taw and Torridge estuaries meet, looking across to Instow. It has 17 bedrooms, split between the pub and a converted sail loft, many with water views and some set up for families or dogs. Food runs from breakfast to dinner, with fish and seafood a focus.
surfTripFit: A characterful base across the estuary from Westward Ho!, but the site gives no beach distance and you would need to drive to the surf.
gaps: Parking, distance to Westward Ho! beach and board storage not stated.
